title: The TLS handshake step by step and what can go wrong

videos.script: Every lesson so far comes together in one exchange of messages, and it happens every time a browser opens a padlock. {{title}} The client says hello. It lists what it can do, and it already sends its half of a key exchange. {{clienthello}} The server answers with its choices and its own half. From that moment both sides can compute the same keys, and everything after is encrypted. {{serverhello}} Then the server proves who it is. It sends its certificate chain, and signs the whole conversation so far with its private key. {{certificate}} Each side finishes with a check over everything that was said, so nothing could have been changed in the middle. {{finished}} One round trip, and the data can flow. This lesson watches it happen in the lab, and then breaks it five different ways. {{failures}}
